en.prompt: Show your users' work with a shot called Showcase Wall. Fill the frame with six masonry columns of website screenshot cards (360px wide, 22px gap, five heights from 202.5 to 480px, column tops staggered), each card a miniature page with its own palette and typeface, and open from black over 0.5s. The whole wall drifts toward the upper left with linear ease (x -440px and y -260px over 5.9s, about 4% of frame width per second) while scale grows linearly from 1 to 1.15. Hold on it for about 1.6s while your product bar rises (0.7s, expo.out), then pull back over 1s with power3.inOut to the whole wall, dim it, and land your wordmark.

en.title: Showcase Wall: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A full-screen wall of website cards drifts diagonally while scaling up, then accelerates into one card. Make this showcase wall with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: A full-screen wall of work cards drifts diagonally at constant speed while slowly scaling up, then accelerates into one card at the end.
en.name: Showcase Wall

body.h2: How to make a Showcase Wall with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Lay out a 2400×1600px wall of six masonry columns of website cards, 360px wide with a 22px gap and column tops staggered between −260 and −40px. Translate it linearly by x −440, y −260 over 5.9s (about 75px per second) while scaling 1 to 1.15 about the frame center. The film opens from black over 0.5s.

The push-in takes 0.65s: an expo.in curve for the first 72%, then a velocity-matched cubic ease-out over the last 0.18s so the card lands softly, while its border radius goes from 10px to 0. Hold 1.65s with a template bar rising at 6.3s, pull back over 1.0s on power3.inOut, and dim the wall under a dark radial overlay for the lockup.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the wall from miniature pages with their own palettes and typefaces. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A tiled wall of website screenshots in many styles: magazine, pricing, podcast and synthesizer pages.
faq: A showcase wall is a grid or masonry layout of many work samples, such as site screenshots, shown at once so the viewer sees how many people use a product. The wall in this film ends by landing on one card.
How do I keep the card wall moving smoothly?

Use constant linear drift and scale so the speed stays even, about 75px per second here (3.9% of frame width). Acceleration happens only in the final push-in, which makes the landing on one card stand out.

zh.description: 满屏网站卡片斜向匀速漂移并慢慢放大，结尾加速推近一张。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个作品墙展示动画。

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做作品墙展示动画
body.body:
排一面 2400×1600px 的墙，六列瀑布流网站卡片，每张宽 360px，间距 22px，各列顶部在 −260 到 −40px 之间错开。墙在 5.9s 内线性平移 x −440、y −260（约每秒 75px），同时围绕画面中心从 1 倍放大到 1.15 倍。影片用 0.5s 从黑场开始。

推近用 0.65s：前 72% 用 expo.in 曲线，最后约 0.18s 换成速度衔接的三次缓出，让卡片轻轻落下，同时圆角从 10px 变为 0。落定后保持 1.65s，6.3s 时模板栏升起；用 power3.inOut 在 1.0s 内拉回，再用深色径向遮罩压暗墙面，给 lockup 让位。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会用一批各有配色和字体的迷你页面搭出这面墙。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 满墙拼贴的网站截图，风格各异：杂志、定价、播客、合成器页面。
faq: 作品墙把大量作品样例（比如网站截图）排成网格或瀑布流，同时展示，让观众看到有多少人在用这款产品。这支片子的作品墙最后落到一张卡片上。
怎样让卡片墙移动得顺滑？
平移和缩放都用恒定的线性速度，这里约每秒 75px（画面宽度的 3.9%）。只有最后的推近才加速，落到一张卡片上才有重点。
